name: COMP_023
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (57%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu holds 37% and sits in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 57%, InSitu 37%, Invasive 7% | Normal leads; InSitu close |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu at 90% | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees with production model |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Normal [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score, but spot check failed [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; compatible with InSitu · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Passes; removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules, necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 8 alone scores 91% invasive risk; the 7% image-level figure may average it away.
- InSitu (37%) is the true class; the model cannot separate it from Normal.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8:** highest heatmap contribution and 91% invasive risk; look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 9, 11:** confirm whether necrosis is real; its spot check was 3/20.
3. **Regions 5, 8, 11:** look for atypical cells confined within ducts versus normal lobules.
